summary: Brother of Temperance Smith (John's 7th-great-grand-uncle); former captain of the Upper Clove militia company.
bio: The Upper Clove company was 'formerly commanded by Capt. Austin Smith'. Fence-viewer and assessor for Woodbury Clove in 1775.
